review_route.rationale: High-risk rollback and path-confinement boundary where a detached-tree observation can be mistaken for current repository truth.

material_finding.summary: LocalRepository validates stored ancestors root-to-leaf and then rechecks only the root. A previously checked first ancestor can be persistently rename-swapped while a deeper scan continues through already-open old descriptors, allowing original bytes from the detached tree to return while the active path contains foreign bytes.
source_evidence: validator/src/repository_fit/local/unix.rs:104-110 validates stored ancestors in root-to-leaf order
validator/src/repository_fit/local/unix.rs:166-183 then verifies only the repository root inode and canonical path

external_reproduction.fixture: root/a/b/FILE with 40000 entries under root/a; alternate/b/FILE contains foreign bytes
external_reproduction.interpretation: The active first ancestor contained foreign bytes for 21478 microseconds before read_file returned, but read_file returned the detached original bytes.

material_finding.contract_impact: Exact active-path confinement is false, so inspect or verify can authorize state from a detached repository tree.

required_correction: revalidate the complete attachment chain leaf-to-root so the root-most descendant attachment is checked last, then revalidate the exact root boundary
fail closed for persistent first and intermediate ancestor substitution without following the substitute
do not add unbounded retries or weaken exact-name symlink special-file enumeration or root checks
add deterministic first-ancestor and intermediate-ancestor substitution controls plus a supported-host external race reproduction

preserved_corrected_behavior.final_rollback_sweep: the prior exact-replacement race and a managed-prior missing-state variant now return RollbackFailed with four CAS calls and four writes; the read-only sweep adds no mutation

highest_defensible_ceiling: The bounded final rollback sweep correction is supported, but full repository-fit internal acceptance is withheld because active-path confinement can observe a detached tree.
explicitly_withheld: supported-host writer and live journey matrix
readiness release node closure or goal completion
